source.semantic_effect: The pre-fix code reused Moran's I normality variance for Geary's C, miscalibrating Geary analytic p-values; the commit notes permutation-based p-values are unaffected.
source.benchmark_task: Compute Geary's C significance using both the analytic normality path and an independent permutation path.
